mentions.name: Nova JavaScript engine
mentions.description: A JavaScript engine that now implements JavaScript object "shapes" (hidden classes), a key performance feature, with planned use of shapes for property lookup caching, API cleanup, and performance-related improvements.
mentions.problem: Without object shapes, property lookups in a JavaScript engine would be terribly slow.
mentions.source_excerpt: I merged support for JavaScript object "shapes" in my Nova JavaScript engine last week
